title: Document size measurement
format: html

## Population and method

This notebook counts the tracked Markdown, MDX, and QMD files at commit `d2add70d5ce58d89c188b7944f561ab9b30477b9` without reading the mutable worktree. The output files are `inventory.csv`, `counts.csv`, and `summary.csv` beside this notebook. It includes imported research as read-only input. The method and its limits are in `method.md`.

```{python}
#| label: document-counts
import csv
import hashlib
import re
import random
import subprocess
import unicodedata
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

SNAPSHOT = "d2add70d5ce58d89c188b7944f561ab9b30477b9"
OUT = Path("research/gates/document-size")
WORD = re.compile(r"[^\W_]+(?:[_'’\-][^\W_]+)*", re.UNICODE)


def normalize(raw: bytes) -> str:
    value = raw.decode("utf-8", errors="strict")
    return unicodedata.normalize("NFC", value.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n"))


def document_class(path: str) -> str:
    if path in {"AGENTS.md", "CLAUDE.md"} or path.startswith(".claude/rules/"):
        return "always-loaded instructions"
    if path.startswith((".claude/agents/", "docs/briefs/", "docs/src/content/docs/workflow/documentation-brief")):
        return "worker briefs"
    if path in {"PLAN.md", "HANDOFF.md", "FABLE_HANDOFF.md"} or path.startswith("docs/src/content/docs/project/"):
        return "plan and handoff"
    if path.startswith("docs/src/content/docs/decisions/"):
        return "decisions"
    if path.startswith("docs/src/content/docs/design/") or path.startswith("design-sketch/"):
        return "design pages"
    if path.startswith(("research/", "experiments/", "reports/", "docs/src/content/docs/research/", "docs/src/content/docs/experiments/", "docs/src/content/docs/retros/", "docs/src/content/docs/devlog/")):
        return "research notes and evidence"
    return "on-demand reference pages"


def word_count(value: str) -> int:
    return len(WORD.findall(value))


for raw, expected in ((b"caf\xc3\xa9\r\nnext\r", "café\nnext\n"), (b"plain\n", "plain\n")):
    assert normalize(raw) == expected
for value, expected in (("one two-three can't résumé", 4), ("", 0), ("a_b 42", 2)):
    assert word_count(value) == expected
for path, expected in (
    ("AGENTS.md", "always-loaded instructions"),
    ("research/imported/example.md", "research notes and evidence"),
    ("docs/src/content/docs/decisions/example.md", "decisions"),
    ("docs/briefs/example.md", "worker briefs"),
    ("docs/src/content/docs/guides/example.md", "on-demand reference pages"),
):
    assert document_class(path) == expected
samples = ("a", "café", "x-y", "front matter", "```code```")
for sample in samples:
    assert word_count(sample + " " + sample) == 2 * word_count(sample)
    assert normalize(normalize(sample.encode()).encode()) == normalize(sample.encode())
generator = random.Random(100)
for _ in range(100):
    sample = "".join(generator.choices("abc_-' 123", k=generator.randrange(30)))
    assert word_count(sample + " " + sample) == 2 * word_count(sample)
    assert normalize(normalize(sample.encode()).encode()) == normalize(sample.encode())
    assert document_class("docs/briefs/" + sample + ".md") == "worker briefs"

paths = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", SNAPSHOT],
    check=True,
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
).stdout.splitlines()
population = sorted(
    path for path in paths
    if path.endswith((".md", ".mdx", ".qmd"))
    and not path.startswith((".holding/", ".worktrees/", "docs/dist/", "docs/.astro/"))
    and not path.endswith((".html.md",))
)
inventory = []
counts = []
for path in population:
    raw = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "show", f"{SNAPSHOT}:{path}"], check=True, capture_output=True
    ).stdout
    value = normalize(raw)
    digest = hashlib.sha256(value.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    kind = document_class(path)
    inventory.append((path, kind, digest, len(raw)))
    counts.append((path, kind, word_count(value), "unavailable", "unavailable", "unavailable", "operator keys not provided"))

for name, header, rows in (
    ("inventory.csv", ("path", "class", "normalized_sha256", "source_bytes"), inventory),
    ("counts.csv", ("path", "class", "words", "openai_tokens", "anthropic_tokens", "google_tokens", "token_status_reason"), counts),
):
    with (OUT / name).open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as stream:
        writer = csv.writer(stream, lineterminator="\n")
        writer.writerow(header)
        writer.writerows(rows)

distribution = defaultdict(list)
for _, kind, words, *_ in counts:
    distribution[kind].append(words)
summary = []
for kind, values in sorted(distribution.items()):
    ordered = sorted(values)
    summary.append((kind, len(ordered), sum(ordered)))
    print(kind, len(ordered), sum(ordered), ordered[(len(ordered) - 1) // 2], ordered[-1])
summary.append(("TOTAL", len(counts), sum(row[2] for row in counts)))
with (OUT / "summary.csv").open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as stream:
    writer = csv.writer(stream, lineterminator="\n")
    writer.writerow(("row_id", "documents", "words"))
    writer.writerows(summary)
print("documents", len(counts), "words", sum(row[2] for row in counts))
```

## Independent sample

The second method scans characters rather than applying the first cell's regular expression. It checks every row, every class total, the headline total, and the ten rows with the lowest SHA-256 of `100|` plus their path bytes. A different-model review remains pending with #107.

```{python}
#| label: independent-word-check
sample = set(
    row[0]
    for row in sorted(counts, key=lambda row: (hashlib.sha256(("100|" + row[0]).encode()).hexdigest(), row[0]))[:10]
)
independent_totals = defaultdict(lambda: [0, 0])
for path, kind, expected, *_ in counts:
    raw = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "show", f"{SNAPSHOT}:{path}"], check=True, capture_output=True
    ).stdout
    value = normalize(raw)
    found = 0
    active = False
    for index, character in enumerate(value):
        if character.isalnum():
            found += not active
            active = True
        elif character in "_'-’" and active and index + 1 < len(value) and value[index + 1].isalnum():
            pass
        else:
            active = False
    assert found == expected, path
    independent_totals[kind][0] += 1
    independent_totals[kind][1] += found
    if path in sample:
        print("sample", path, found)
assert sum(value[0] for value in independent_totals.values()) == 128
assert sum(value[1] for value in independent_totals.values()) == 266716
for kind, value in sorted(independent_totals.items()):
    print("verified", kind, *value)
```
